test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is the following statement is INCORRECT?

options.text: Saffron is cultivated in Jammu and Kashmir.
V Kurien is the Father of the White Revolution in India.
Madhya Pradesh is the highest copper producing state of India.
The Radcliffe line is the boundary between India and China.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Radcliffe line is the boundary between India and China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• ​The **Radcliffe Line** was the boundary demarcated between the Indian and Pakistani portions of the Punjab Province and the Bengal Presidency of British India.
 
• It was named after its architect, **Cyril Radcliffe**, who, as the joint chairman of the two boundary commissions for the two provinces, received the responsibility to equitably divide 175,000 square miles of territory with 88 million people.
 
• The demarcation line was published on **17 August 1947** upon the Partition of British India.
 
• Today, its western side is part of the** India–Pakistan border** while its eastern side serves as the** Bangladesh–India border**.
 
• The **Radcliffe line** is spread through the Rann of Kutch in Gujarat to the international border in Jammu in Jammu & Kashmir, dividing India and Pakistan into two different countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **McMahon Line** is the boundary between India and China.
 
• In Jammu and Kashmir, four districts – Pulwama, Budgam, Srinagar, and Kishtwar grow **saffron**. 
 
• **V Kurien** was given the title 'The Milkman of India' because he created milk powder using buffalo milk when the world was still using milk. Hence he is called the "Father of the White Revolution in India".
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is the leading producer of copper in India. It accounts for producing 53% of copper in this country.
